intervals.label: E616 (as "CCFRR") and E701 runs
intervals.locator: History of Neutrinos at Lab E
intervals.note: Year precision. E701 "took data in 1982" (same page). Earlier incarnation of the collaboration ("CCFRR": Caltech, Columbia, Fermilab, Rochester, Rockefeller) with a narrow-band 400 GeV beam and spark chambers.
intervals.quote: E616, run in 1979, was the first experiment to take advantage of the high-energy neutrino beam in Lab E.

intervals.label: E744 run
intervals.locator: History of Neutrinos at Lab E
intervals.note: Year precision; Tevatron 800 GeV protons, quadrupole-triplet wide-band beam, drift chambers.
intervals.quote: The Lab E neutrino era hit its stride with E744, run in 1985, and E770, run in 1987 and 1988.

intervals.label: E770 run
intervals.locator: History of Neutrinos at Lab E
intervals.note: Year precision. The CCFR home page states that the collaboration collected data in two fixed-target runs, in 1985 (E744) and 1987-88 (E770).
intervals.quote: The Lab E neutrino era hit its stride with E744, run in 1985, and E770, run in 1987 and 1988.

intervals.label: completed (CCFR data taking; detector continued as NuTeV)
intervals.note: Terminal event: the end of the 1987-88 run. The Lab E detector was reused by the NuTeV collaboration (E815) in 1996-97, which has its own record.
intervals.quote: The CCFR collaboration collected data from two fixed-target runs at Fermilab in 1985 (experiment E744) and 1987-88 (experiment E770).

placements.note: The existing Fermilab main-campus site (campus-grade) is reused: Lab E is in the fixed-target area of the Fermilab site; its own coordinate is not published in the sources read.
placements.quote: The CCFR experiment collected data using the Fermilab Tevatron Quad-Triplet wide-band νµ and ν µ beam.

total_mass.quote: neutrino interactions occur in the 690 ton unmagnetized steel-scintillator target-calorimeter

summary.plain: A 690-tonne wall of steel plates interleaved with plastic scintillator and tracking chambers, followed by a magnetised iron muon spectrometer, in Lab E at Fermilab.
summary.technical: Unmagnetised steel-scintillator target calorimeter (690 t, hadronic resolution 0.85/sqrt(E)) instrumented with drift chambers for muon tracking, followed by a solid-iron toroidal spectrometer (dp = 0.11 p); in 1996-97 reused by NuTeV.
